translations.settings.title: Settings
translations.settings.languageHint: The app reloads in the chosen language.
translations.settings.favouriteDoublesHint: The checkout suggestion prefers to finish on the top double, then on the next ones, as long as the setup does not get harder for it. Without a choice the standard order applies.
translations.settings.advanceOnPullHint: The camera notices when the darts are pulled and hands over to the next player. Otherwise play only moves on once you confirm.
translations.settings.announcementTestHint: Calls out a phrase on this device.
translations.settings.evaluationHint: For new games and the running one, saves the camera images of every corrected visit as a throw series, plus every image of a failed calibration.
translations.auth.usernamePattern: Only letters, digits, full stop, hyphen or underscore.
translations.auth.currentPasswordWrong: The current password is not correct.
translations.auth.linkInvalid: The link is invalid or has expired.
translations.auth.sendFailed: Sending failed. Please try again later.
translations.auth.account.title: Account
translations.auth.login.failed: The sign-in details are not correct.
translations.auth.register.title: Create account
translations.auth.register.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: letters, digits, full stop, hyphen or underscore.
translations.auth.register.displayNameHint: This is how you appear in the player list. It does not have to be unique.
translations.auth.register.privacy: What happens to your data is described in the {$START_LINK}privacy policy{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.auth.register.taken: Email or username is already taken.
translations.auth.register.failed: Registration failed. Please check your details.
translations.auth.forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
translations.auth.forgotPassword.subtitle: We will send you a link to reset it
translations.auth.forgotPassword.sent: If an account with this address exists, an email with the link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
translations.auth.forgotPassword.failed: The request failed. Please try again later.
translations.auth.resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. You need to sign in again on all devices.
translations.auth.verifyEmail.title: Confirm email
translations.auth.verifyEmail.resent: A new confirmation link is on its way.
translations.auth.verifyEmail.taken: This address is now used by another account.
translations.auth.verifyEmail.changed: Your new email address is confirmed and active from now on.
translations.auth.verifyEmail.failed: The address could not be confirmed right now.
translations.auth.deleteAccount.hint: Your account, your player list, your settings and the games no other account played in will be deleted for good. Shared games remain for the others; in them you only appear as “Deleted player”.
translations.auth.changeEmail.hint: We will send a link to the new address. It only becomes active once you open it.
translations.auth.changeEmail.sent: Confirmation link sent to {$email}. Until you open it, your current address stays active.
translations.auth.changeEmail.unchanged: That is already your current address.
translations.auth.changeEmail.taken: This address is already used by another account.
translations.auth.changeEmail.failed: The request failed. Please try again.
translations.auth.changePassword.hint: At least 8 characters. Other devices will be signed out.
translations.auth.changePassword.done: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
translations.auth.profile.title: Profile
translations.auth.profile.verificationSent: A new confirmation link is on its way. It is valid for 24 hours.
translations.auth.profile.unverified: Your email address is not confirmed yet. You will find the link in your inbox.
translations.auth.profile.nameInAddressBook: This name is already in your player list.
translations.auth.profile.saveFailed: Saving failed. Please check your details.
